units.source_text: 夕雾动身之时，对家人说：“今日若不去吊，以后日子不好，不宜出行。

en.t: When Yugiri was about to set out, he told his household, "If I do not go to pay my respects today, the coming days will be unlucky, and it will not be suitable to travel.

units.source_text: ”实则他推想公主一定十分悲戚，不胜挂念，所以立刻前往。

en.t: In truth, he imagined that the princess must be deeply grief-stricken, and because he could not stop worrying about her, he went at once.

units.source_text: 家人劝他不必如此急急。

en.t: His family urged him that there was no need to hurry so much.

units.source_text: 但他定欲出门。

en.t: But he was determined to go out.

units.source_text: 路程甚远，好容易到达山庄，但见景象异常凄惨。

en.t: The road was very long, and when he finally reached the mountain villa, the scene before him was extraordinarily bleak and sorrowful.

units.source_text: 遗骸用屏风围着，不教来客看见，样子阴森可怕。

en.t: The body was enclosed by screens so that visitors could not see it, giving the place a gloomy and frightening air.

units.source_text: 夕雾被延入老夫人起居室西边的一室中，大和守啼哭着前来接待。

en.t: Yugiri was shown into a room west of the old lady's living quarters, where Yamato no Kami came forward weeping to receive him.

units.source_text: 夕雾靠在边门外的栏杆上，召侍女前来。

en.t: Yugiri leaned against the railing outside a side door and summoned a gentlewoman to come to him.

units.source_text: 众侍女由于伤心过度，个个都神思恍惚。

en.t: All the gentlewomen, overwhelmed by sorrow, seemed dazed and absent-minded.

units.source_text: 但因夕雾亲自惠临，诸人略觉喜慰，小少将君便前来应对。

en.t: But because Yugiri had come in person, they felt a little comforted, and Ko-Shosho no Kimi came forward to speak with him.

units.source_text: 夕雾看见了她，一时说不出话来。

en.t: When Yugiri saw her, he could not speak for a while.

units.source_text: 他向来性情坚强，不容易流泪。

en.t: By nature he had always been strong and was not easily moved to tears.

units.source_text: 但此时看到这凄惨情景，想起老夫人生前模样，实在不胜感慨。

en.t: But seeing this miserable scene and remembering how the old lady had been in life, he was overcome with emotion.

units.source_text: 而且这人世无常之相，不是传闻而是亲见，因此悲痛万分。

en.t: Moreover, he was seeing the impermanence of this world with his own eyes rather than merely hearing of it, and his grief was profound.

units.source_text: 好容易镇静下来，叫小少将君转达公主：“前闻老夫人病势好转，我便疏忽大意了。

en.t: When he had finally calmed himself, he asked Ko-Shosho no Kimi to tell the princess, "I heard earlier that the old lady's illness had improved, and I let myself grow careless.

units.source_text: 做梦也得过些时间方醒。

en.t: Even from a dream, one needs some time before waking.

units.source_text: 比梦醒得还快，真教人不胜惊骇！

en.t: For this to happen even more quickly than waking from a dream is truly shocking beyond words!

units.source_text: ”公主想道：“我母亲如此忧伤而死，多半是为了此人。

en.t: The princess thought, "My mother died in such grief, and most likely it was because of this man.

units.source_text: 虽说是前生注定，这孽缘实在可恨。

en.t: Though it may have been destined from a former life, this ill-fated bond is truly hateful.

units.source_text: ”因此置之不答。

en.t: So she left his message unanswered.

units.source_text: 众侍女异口同声地劝道：“教我们怎样答复他呢？

en.t: The gentlewomen all urged her with one voice, "How are we to answer him?

units.source_text: 大将身份高贵，特地急忙来吊，确是一片诚心。

en.t: The general is of high rank, and he has hurried here especially to pay his respects; surely his sincerity is genuine.

units.source_text: 如果置之不答，未免太不礼貌。

en.t: If you leave him without an answer, it would be far too discourteous.

units.source_text: ”公主答道：“听凭你们推量我心，代为答复吧。

en.t: The princess replied, "Please judge my feelings for yourselves and answer on my behalf.

units.source_text: 我已不知所云了。

en.t: I no longer know what I am saying.

units.source_text: ”说过就躺下身子，这原也是难怪的。

en.t: After saying this she lay down, which was only understandable.

units.source_text: 小少将君便出去对夕雾说：“此刻公主昏厥，几同亡人一样了。

en.t: Ko-Shosho no Kimi then went out and said to Yugiri, "At this moment the princess has fainted and is almost like one who has passed away.

units.source_text: 大驾光临，今已禀告。

en.t: I have now informed her of your gracious visit.

units.source_text: ”这些侍女说话都已泣不成声。

en.t: By this time the gentlewomen were sobbing so hard that they could hardly speak.

units.source_text: 夕雾便道：“我也无法安慰她了。

en.t: Yugiri said, "I too have no way to comfort her.

units.source_text: 且待我自己心情稍定，公主哀思稍懈，再来拜访吧。

en.t: I will come to visit again after my own feelings have settled somewhat and the princess's grief has eased a little.

units.source_text: 但老夫人此次突然仙逝，不知何故，乞道其详。

en.t: But I do not know why the old lady passed away so suddenly this time; please tell me the details.

units.source_text: ”小少将君便把老夫人等待夕雾不来而忧伤之状约略告知，末了说道：“这话似是埋怨大将了。

en.t: Ko-Shosho no Kimi then told him briefly how the old lady had grieved while waiting for Yugiri, who did not come, and at the end she said, "These words may sound as if I am blaming you, my lord.

units.source_text: 实因今日心绪缭乱，语言未免错乱。

en.t: It is only that today my mind is in confusion, and my words are bound to be disordered.

units.source_text: 大将既欲详询，则公主悲哀之思终有限制，且待公主心情稍定，再行奉告，并请指教。

en.t: Since you wish to ask in detail, and since the princess's grief must in time have some limit, please wait until her feelings have settled a little; then we will report everything and ask your guidance.

units.source_text: ”夕雾见她说时神情昏迷，便觉自己欲说的话也难于出口。

en.t: Seeing her dazed expression as she spoke, Yugiri felt that even the things he himself wanted to say were difficult to bring out.

units.source_text: 后来说道：“我也觉得心绪缭乱了。

en.t: After a while he said, "I too feel that my mind is in confusion.

units.source_text: 还望你善言劝慰公主，请她复我片言只语也好。

en.t: I hope you will comfort the princess with kind words and ask her to send me even a word or two in reply.

units.source_text: ”他舍不得立刻回去。

en.t: He could not bear to return at once.

units.source_text: 终于因为此时人目众多，如果久留不去，恐被视为轻率，只得起身告辞。

en.t: In the end, because many eyes were on him and a long stay might be seen as rash, he had no choice but to rise and take his leave.

units.source_text: 他想不到今夜就要殡葬，觉得排场过分简单，实在太不像样，便召集附近庄园中人员，一一吩咐，叫他们照料一应事宜，然后离去。

en.t: He had not expected the funeral rites to be held that very night, and feeling that the arrangements were far too simple and truly unseemly, he gathered people from the nearby estates, gave each of them instructions, had them attend to all necessary matters, and then departed.

units.source_text: 此事突然发生，以致葬仪过分简单。

en.t: Because the event had happened so suddenly, the funeral rites had been excessively simple.

units.source_text: 今得夕雾协助，气象忽然庄严，送葬人数也增添不少。

en.t: Now, with Yugiri's help, the atmosphere suddenly became solemn, and the number of people in the funeral procession increased considerably.

units.source_text: 因此大和守不胜欣慰，十分感激夕雾的好意。

en.t: For this reason Yamato no Kami was deeply relieved and felt great gratitude for Yugiri's kindness.

units.source_text: 落叶公主想起母亲即将化作灰尘，心中不胜悲痛，只管匍匐号哭。

en.t: Princess Ochiba thought of her mother soon turning to ash, and in unbearable grief she could only crawl forward and wail.

units.source_text: 旁人睹此情状，觉得虽是母女，实在不宜过分亲爱。

en.t: Those around her, seeing this, felt that even between mother and daughter such excessive attachment was not really fitting.

units.source_text: 如今公主悲痛若此，恐对自身亦甚不利。

en.t: Now that the princess was grieving so intensely, they feared it would also be very harmful to her own health.

units.source_text: 于是大家伤心叹息。

en.t: So everyone sighed in sorrow.

units.source_text: 大和守对公主说：“此间景象凄惨，不宜久留。

en.t: Yamato no Kami said to the princess, "The scene here is too sorrowful; you should not remain long.

units.source_text: 长住在此，悲痛将无了时。

en.t: If you continue living here, your grief will never come to an end.

units.source_text: ”但公主总想接近山中火葬之烟，以便回忆母亲，因此定欲终身居住在这山庄中。

en.t: But the princess wished always to be near the smoke of the cremation in the mountains so that she could remember her mother, and so she was determined to live in this mountain villa for the rest of her life.

units.source_text: 东面的走廊及杂舍中，略施间隔，七七期间做功德的僧人住在其中，悄悄地诵经念佛。

en.t: In the eastern corridor and the outbuildings, simple partitions were set up, and monks performing the forty-nine days of memorial rites stayed there, quietly chanting sutras and reciting the Buddha's name.

units.source_text: 西厢改用丧中装饰，由公主居住。

en.t: The western wing was refitted with mourning decorations, and the princess lived there.

units.source_text: 公主就在其中无昼无夜地度送悲伤的岁月，不觉已到深秋九月。

en.t: There the princess passed sorrowful days without distinction between day and night, and before she knew it, deep autumn had arrived in the ninth month.
